videos.title: Tiburón vs. atún
videos.description: Un choque entre dos gigantes oceánicos en las costas de la remota isla de Ascensión. Los atunes son más grandes, rápidos y fuertes que los tiburones, pero los escualos tienen un instinto asesino sin parangón en el reino animal.

videos.title: Tiburones caníbales

videos.title: China: misteriosa y salvaje
videos.description: Escondida en las montañas más remotas, a casi 4800 metros sobre el nivel del mar, la vida silvestre más tenaz enfrenta batallas para sobrevivir a diario. Un vistazo al leopardo de las nieves a medida que le da a sus crías lecciones vitales.

videos.title: China: misteriosa y salvaje

videos.title: China: misteriosa y salvaje

videos.title: China: misteriosa y salvaje

videos.title: China: misteriosa y salvaje

videos.title: Yukon Vet

videos.title: Yukon Vet
videos.description: La doctora Michelle Oakley hace frente a un violento carcayú. Además, viaja a Alaska para ayudar a unas crías de reno y de alce.

videos.title: Yukon Vet
videos.description: La Dra. Oakley examina por primera vez a ocho cachorros de perros de trineo, ayuda a rodear a un grupo de caballos rebeldes, atiende a un poni con un absceso en la mandíbula, y atiende una llamada de emergencia a medianoche en la clínica.

videos.title: Yukon Vet
videos.description: El verano es fuerte en Yukón y los días más largos del año representan problemas para los animales. La Dra. Michelle cuida a un perro que fue atacado por un puercoespín y salva a una cría de alce.

videos.title: Yukon Vet
videos.description: Llega el verano a Yukón y las emergencias se suceden sin fin. Así, la Dra. Michelle atiende a un alce joven con verrugas que podrían dejarlo ciego, una cabra con una pata mutilada, un perro con un tumor y un hurón con piedras en los riñones.

videos.title: Yukon Vet

videos.title: Cuando los tiburones atacan
videos.description: En Australia se experimentan nueve ataques de tiburones en 2015.

videos.title: Cuando los tiburones atacan

videos.title: Patriot Games
videos.description: When former CIA agent Jack Ryan (Harrison Ford) hampers an IRA terrorist attack in London, he kills one of the terrorists. The dead man's brother, another member of the group named Sean Miller (Sean Bean), is arrested but quickly escapes. Vowing revenge against Ryan, Miller travels to the United States, where he forces Ryan's wife (Anne Archer) and daughter (Thora Birch) into a car accident that badly injures them. This convinces Ryan to rejoin the CIA in order to track down Miller.

videos.title: Reindeer Games
videos.description: Just released from prison, all Rudy Duncan (Ben Affleck) wants is to start a new life with Ashley (Charlize Theron), the girl of his dreams, whom he met through pen pal letters in prison. But between them and happiness stands her crazy brother, Gabriel (Gary Sinise), and his motley crue of deadly criminals who think Rudy has some inside information about a casino where he once had a job -- a casino Gabriel and his short-fused posse plan to take down.

videos.title: Argo
videos.description: On Nov. 4, 1979, militants storm the U.S. embassy in Tehran, Iran, taking 66 American hostages. Amid the chaos, six Americans manage to slip away and find refuge with the Canadian ambassador. Knowing that it's just a matter of time before the refugees are found and likely executed, the U.S. government calls on extractor Tony Mendez (Ben Affleck) to rescue them. Mendez's plan is to pose as a Hollywood producer scouting locations in Iran and train the refugees to act as his "film" crew.

videos.title: Godzilla
videos.description: Ford Brody (Aaron Taylor-Johnson), a Navy bomb expert, has just reunited with his family in San Francisco when he is forced to go to Japan to help his estranged father, Joe (Bryan Cranston). Soon, both men are swept up in an escalating crisis when Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises from the sea to combat malevolent adversaries that threaten the survival of humanity. The creatures leave colossal destruction in their wake, as they make their way toward their final battleground: San Francisco.

videos.title: The Foreigner
videos.description: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers.

videos.title: Ballistic
videos.description: Beck, a homeless veteran, learns his sister's killer is free after early prison release, sparking his quest for revenge.

videos.title: Flags of Our Fathers
videos.description: In February and March 1945, U.S. troops fight and win one of the most crucial and costly battles of the war on the island of Iwo Jima. A photo of U.S. servicemen raising the flag on Mount Suribachi becomes an iconic symbol of victory to a war-weary nation. The individuals themselves become heroes, though not all survive the war and realize it.

videos.title: Behind Enemy Lines
videos.description: A Navy pilot (Owen Wilson) is shot down over enemy territory, and struggles to survive the relentless pursuit of a ruthless secret police enforcer, a deadly tracker, and countless hostile troops. With time running out, the injured pilot's commanding officer (Gene Hackman) goes against orders to carry out a desperate rescue mission.
